name: Phonon-2 Core ML
weights: exact five-value palettes (sparse-g16-6b: 1-bit zero mask + 64-entry fp16 LUT per 16 output rows), 16-bit float activations; one weight blob shared by all functions; relative keys constant-folded per function (centred slices of the 15 s table; relative_k_proj in-graph for the pos-input function); 264 encoder linears are exact 4-bit instead (int4 x per-16-row scale: 16-entry fp16 LUT per 16 output rows, uint4 indices, no zero mask)
inputs: mel [1,128,T] normalised log-mel, zero-padded to the function's length; m1/m2/m3 frame masks after each stride-2 conv; kmask additive key mask over encoder frames (0 / -1e4); pos [1,2*T3-1,1024] relative-position table (functions with pos_input only)
output: enc [1,T3,640] = encoder output after the projector; greedy TDT (durations 0-4, blank 8192, at most 10 symbols per frame) with decoder.bin
decoder_bin: prediction network, joint and vocabulary: uncompressed float16 matrices and biases (format v3), fp32 accumulate in the app
